title: Capability endpoints share one fetch path in utils/server_info.py; new probes must reuse it
answers: how to add another server capability endpoint to the REST client
where server-info and server-features HTTP fetching lives
why server-features and server-info parse JSON the same way
body:
Invariant: every capability endpoint fetch goes through mlflow/utils/server_info.py:_fetch_server_info_response(host_creds, endpoint), which owns the http_request call (timeout=3, max_retries=0), JSON-object validation and ServerInfoRequestError messages that embed the endpoint.
Wrappers: _fetch_server_info_uncached (cached path via fetch_server_info) and _fetch_server_features are thin wrappers that pass a constant (SERVER_INFO_ENDPOINT, SERVER_FEATURES_ENDPOINT).
What breaks if skipped: a new probe with its own http_request call duplicates the parsing and error text, and drifts from the messages that workspace_rest_store_mixin.py matches on.
Endpoint paths are module constants in the same file; do not hard-code them in callers.
applies: Adding or changing server capability probes used by REST stores.
says: The client should check for newly supported server capabilities using standard feature probes.
Server feature detection errors should provide consistent messages when endpoints fail or timeout.
Add a new capability check to determine if the tracking server supports specific features.
Inconsistent error formatting when probing tracking server version and supported functionality.
Tracking client capability requests should share timeout settings and response validation.

Wrappers _fetch_server_info_uncached and _fetch_server_features pass module constants SERVER_INFO_ENDPOINT and SERVER_FEATURES_ENDPOINT rather than hardcoding paths. Bypassing this shared path duplicates parsing and drifts from error messages matched by workspace_rest_store_mixin.py.
